notes.subject: רשפים
notes.rationale: Sapot olsem kol bilong paia o laitning o faia-olon; KJV 'hot thunderbolts', JPS 'fiery bolts'.

notes.subject: בעירם / מקניהם
notes.rationale: Tupela tok i tok wankain klostu (bulmakau / ol animal bilong gaden) — pasin bilong statim tok i kamap tupela taim.

notes.subject: לברד
notes.gloss: barad em i ais i faulap; Tok Pisin i gat wanpela tok, mi usim 'ol ston bilong ais'.

translation: Em i givim ol bulmakau bilong ol long ol ston bilong ais, na ol sipsip na meme bilong ol long ol laitning bilong paia.

tokens.gloss: na ol sipsip na meme bilong ol
